turn1.explanation: The unit responds to two unrelated things: close-up cat faces and cars, especially the front or hood and body panels of cars.
turn1.evidence: The top activations (9-7) are mostly cat faces, with a red Mercedes at #3. Cars and trucks (#10-19) and cats (#16, #20) are interleaved at activations 6-5, and there is no shared visual feature linking the two groups.
turn1.missing_data: Activations on other animals (dogs, other furry faces) and on other vehicles or shiny curved surfaces would show whether there is a hidden common feature, and a random sample of photos at a range of activations would also help.
